sampling.population: all retained cells, living or dead
sampling.order: ascending keyed SplitMix64 score, then cell ID
sampling.missing: retain empty slots and censuses outside registered case horizon

control_law.phase_order: one registered resource cycle, declared edits, remaining three resource cycles, paid birth; resource-before-edit as in shared population law

lineage_rule.novel_organization: first executable reaction stage absent from founder and prior retained organization; all neutral duplicates remain recorded
lineage_rule.identity: founder origin or native edit cell/receipt index; inherited by actual paid birth mapping
lineage_rule.ancestor_cutoff: stop parent history at the birth of the next member on the selected path
lineage_rule.candidate_pairs: all ordered pairs of retained novel stage organizations, never ranked by assay outcomes
lineage_rule.activity: actual metabolic native receipts using retained organization
lineage_rule.origin: authored probes, external edits and seeded founder material are never autonomous discovery

assay.unfunded_copy: retain full resource horizon and refused copy status; candidate cannot pass if any comparison is unfunded
assay.score: parent final capital plus transferred child capital minus initial capital; diagnostic child environment excluded
assay.group_removal: remove every endpoint gene of the acquired stage; preserve remaining order
assay.padding: replace removed earlier-stage genes with legal nonexecutable stage -1, retaining storage and copy load
assay.single_removal: remove only first earlier-stage copy to expose redundancy
assay.sham: rebuild identical program in a separate native assay
assay.restoration: reinsert group at original positions; separate native assay
assay.cache: role plus exact stage sequence; all requests fixed before native outcomes

remaining_readiness: appropriate bounded program and mutable editor repertoire
whole-campaign resource projection and replicate justification
scientific candidate rule and thresholds frozen prospectively on new worlds
